# Biomes

The kinds of living cover a world cell can have (A5.7 step 10, `WLD-31`): each takes its own look on the map (A11.5, `PRE-29`) and starts its cells with its shares of the five cover groups: trees, bushes, grass and herbs, reeds, and bare ground, which sum to the whole cell.
The first region has woods, grassland, marsh, shore and sea; the rest of the world's biomes join with generation (α21).

## Broadleaf forest

Oak, elm, lime and hazel woods with glades, the island's own cover.

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Map look | Woodland |
| Cover | trees 55%, bushes 15%, grass and herbs 25%, reeds 2% and bare ground 3% |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "broadleaf_forest"
name = "Broadleaf forest"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["WLD-31", "PRE-29"]
look = "woodland"
cover = { trees = 0.55, bushes = 0.15, grass = 0.25, reeds = 0.02, bare = 0.03 }
```

## Barren

Bare ground where nothing grows, for the test lands that hold no plant at all (α04b), so a body's needs can be tried with no food to find (`BIO-09`).
